gen-flavors-gf-voces: Voces reads tall and tidy, with hairlines close to its stems, while Flavors swaggers on top. Page after page, it would feel steady, unhurried and easy on the eye.
gen-flavors-gf-winky-rough: Whimsical Flavors towers up top, while Winky Rough stays low, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals in height. That gap in stature is what makes the two work together.
gen-flavors-gf-winky-sans: Rope-like curves up top: Flavors commands the line, while Winky Sans sits low beneath as a plain sans. Big and small, loud and low, that gap is the draw.
gen-flavors-plus-jakarta-sans: Precise curves with well-spaced endings define Plus Jakarta Sans, while Flavors above it stands tall and commanding. Reading it feels smooth, with a moderate lowercase that never crowds.
gen-fredoka-fs-asap: Asap reads low and readable, its capitals nearly matching lowercase height, while Fredoka rounds out the heading with friendly, full-walled letters. Paragraph after paragraph, it stays smooth and undemanding.
gen-fs-azeret-mono-fs-asap: Technical Azeret Mono spaces its letters out wide like code. Asap, a plain sans with open arcs, keeps long paragraphs easy going, its lowercase sitting close to capital height.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-quando: Marker-tip curves, no snags: Chubbo glides along as one thick thread, while Quando follows, widely spaced, as a serif. Next to each other, they feel relaxed, casual and bookish.
gen-fs-excon-gf-courier-prime: Courier Prime fills most of its height with lowercase, and its round letters have generous mouths. And beneath chalk-tight Excon, the monospace body keeps a steady, drafting-pen pace down the page.
gen-fs-excon-gf-esteban: Approachable Excon crowds its letters like chalk on a slate, while Esteban brings a refined serif with a hint of wedge-shaped pen pressure. Its oversized lowercase stays open and unsqueezed.
gen-fs-excon-gf-major-mono-display: Excon packs its letters tight, like chalk marks on a slate. Major Mono Display, a monospace body, glows like neon glass, its wide sidebearings giving the crowding above room to breathe.
